item.title: Ask HN: How do you use AI for learning?
item.summary: This is an interesting use case that gets talked about much less, and potentially one that is more useful than software development. Especially now that everyone is relying heavily on AI and even forgetting things they used to know. Have you explored this yourself or found any existing workflows for mastering technologies, concepts, theory, basically everything that we have traditionally learned manually, from university onward?
